note: Responses of the API for the synthetic layered-small deposit (seed 42), geology built and block model coded through the endpoints. Synthetic data only. `detail.spec` is set to null to keep the file small.

throw.note: the rock model shows an offset at the fault
the rock model shows an offset at the fault

residuals.note: logged rock unit against the grid labels of the model at points along the holes; the cover and the air are labelled by their surfaces and count as differences

volumes.method: one point per grid cell, shifted in plan from level to level, grid labels; the drilled hull is the convex hull of the logged hole points

cross_validation.note: not run by the build; `bakumine geology cv DB --spec SPEC --out cv.csv`
